Hero.badge: Hand-checked · Traded worldwide · Ships to your door
Hero.body: Send a card to the Idolca vault once. We check it by hand, photograph both sides and pair it with a digital collectible that certifies it as authentic and yours for good. From then on it can pass to a fan anywhere in the world in seconds, without a parcel. Buying from another fan? Your payment is held until the card arrives. Whenever you want it in your hands, we ship it to your door.

How.title: What makes Idolca different
How.subtitle: Collecting shouldn't stop at a border, or end with a lost parcel.
How.s1Body: Every vault card is inspected in person and photographed front and back, so the card you see is the card you get. Its digital collectible is a permanent, public certificate.
How.s2Body: The card stays safe in the vault while it changes owners in seconds. A fan in Jakarta can buy from a fan in Toronto, right now.
How.s3Body: Every card has the same price for fans everywhere. Pay from any country, with no currency exchange and no cross-border bank fees.
How.s4Body: When you buy from a fan who still holds the card, your payment is held until it arrives. No shipment within 7 days means a full refund.

Grading.metaDescription: Idolca Grading (IDG) authenticates K-pop photocards by hand, scores them on four criteria and gives every graded card a public record.
Grading.title: Every photocard gets an ID
Grading.subtitle: IDG is Idolca's grading for photocards in our vault. Each card is authenticated by hand, scored on four criteria and given a public record anyone can check.
Grading.whyTitle: Why photocards need their own grading
Grading.why1Title: Big graders aren't built for photocards
Grading.why1Body: Mainstream grading costs tens of dollars a card and can take months, more than most photocards are worth.
Grading.why2Body: Outside a few large graders, a grade is a label on a sleeve. A buyer on another platform has no way to look it up.
Grading.why3Body: Without a shared record, the same card can be relisted anywhere with any story attached.
Grading.step1Body: The card is mailed into the Idolca vault and checked by hand. Only authentic cards are graded.
Grading.step2Body: Centering, corners, edges and surface, from 1 to 10 in half-point steps.
Grading.step3Title: The vault serial is the cert number
Grading.step3Body: Each graded card keeps its IC- serial for life, printed on its sleeve label.
Grading.step4Body: The grade is written into the card's digital collectible and shown on its card page, next to its photos and its public record.
Grading.scaleBody: Half points sit between the steps below, for example IDG 9.5.
Grading.scale10: Gem Mint: flawless to the eye
Grading.scale9: Mint: one tiny flaw under close look
Grading.scale8: Near Mint–Mint: light wear on one corner or edge
Grading.scale7: Near Mint: slight wear on corners or edges
Grading.scale6: Excellent–Mint: visible wear or a small print flaw
Grading.scale4: Very Good–Excellent: noticeable rounding or scuffs
Grading.thirdBody: We record {graders} grades too, with the grader and cert number. PSA and CGC certs link straight to their public lookup.
Grading.honestBody: IDG is Idolca's in-house grading, and Idolca also sells cards. So every IDG grade is marked as our own on the card page, kept apart from third-party grades, and backed by photos anyone can compare.
Grading.ctaTitle: Get your card an IDG grade
Grading.ctaBody: Send a card into the vault from your binder. Once it's authenticated it can be graded, and it trades without shipping again.
